meta.title: DSH Ding
meta.description: Play a sound when a turn finishes, when the agent needs your reply, or when a turn fails. Pick a bundled chime or your own audio file.

enabled.label: Enable DSH Ding
enabled.hint: Turn every chime off without uninstalling the plugin.

completed.label: Turn finished
completed.hint: Play when a turn completes normally.

needsReply.label: Needs your reply
needsReply.hint: Play when the agent asks a question or a tool needs approval.

failed.label: Turn failed
failed.hint: Play on an error or when the model runs out of tokens.

aborted.label: You interrupted it
aborted.hint: Play when you stop the turn yourself.

topLevelOnly.label: Ignore subagents
topLevelOnly.hint: Skip chimes from delegated subagent work.

quietOnViewing.label: Quiet while viewing
quietOnViewing.hint: Stay silent when the finished conversation is the one already on your screen in a focused window.

soundPreset.label: Chime
soundPreset.hint: Pick one of the bundled sounds.

soundPath.label: Custom audio file
soundPath.hint: Absolute path to a wav, mp3 or flac file. Overrides the chime above when set.

command.label: Custom player command
command.hint: Advanced. {file} is replaced with the audio path.

status.customMissing: That file does not exist; the chime below is used instead.
status.noSettings: The settings service is unavailable, so this page cannot read or save values.
status.noNamespace: This plugin's configuration namespace was not found. Re-enable the plugin to recreate it.
status.readOnly: Saved by this plugin but not written by the Harness settings service; changes may not persist.
